selection.rule: exactly one ACCEPTED and one REJECTED labelled rollout per task

taxonomy.valid_terminal_object: The task-owned clean-room verifier accepted the exact terminal mathematics, bindings, scope, evidence, and assurance.
taxonomy.intermediate_semantic_binding: Exact subcomputations were correct but a fixed input parameter or named relation was rebound incorrectly in the terminal object.
taxonomy.noncanonical_representation_rejected: A capability correctly rejected duplicate, zero, or out-of-order sparse terms before making a mathematical claim.
taxonomy.failed_recovery_after_tool_rejection: The agent did not recover a valid mathematical route after a fail-closed capability response.
taxonomy.recoverable_reasoning_protocol_error: One or more reasoning.write attempts were invalid, while the durable PLAN-to-FINAL protocol still completed.
taxonomy.trajectory_extractor_false_candidate: The post-run extractor misclassified certificate metadata as a mathematical candidate and could not digest the scalar URI.
taxonomy.safe_nonconclusion: The terminal object preserved bounded or incomplete evidence as UNKNOWN without a global inference.

The second exact two-sided verification matched the first.

The authorized checker returned FALSE after replaying both complete residual families.
The first duplicate-term request failed closed; two canonical identities then supported a correct complete two-direction terminal replay.
Two exact normalizations exposed the cancellations needed to avoid relying on one-direction supplied evidence.
The exact determinant was one, while the terminal object correctly withheld any unlicensed global invertibility conclusion.
The independent checker verified only the Keller condition and the terminal scope remained local to that claim.
Two distinct rational points were exactly evaluated to the same image and bound as a collision witness.

The terminal certificate stayed within the completely enumerated finite grid and made no global injectivity claim.

The second rollout canonicalized both residual families to zero and the terminal verifier independently replayed the complete compositions.

limitations: This is a 24-run public host-local calibration, not a held-out or causal comparison.
Only one of twelve tasks met the preregistered mixed-outcome criterion, so the separately preregistered extension is required.
The extension is enriched for unused representation-heavy fixtures and cannot support a population-level difficulty estimate.
Ten post-run extraction failures are evaluator heuristic defects; their raw traces and task-owned terminal labels remain intact.
Raw transcripts are host-local ignored artifacts; this record binds their complete manifest and summary digests.
